title: Rust Harp
description: A low-latency digital instrument for Android and Linux, inspired by the autoharp and written in Rust. Swiping across a line plays a note, and simple cardinal-direction gestures change chords. On Linux it acts as a virtual MIDI device (great with a bumpy-covered drawing tablet for haptic 'string' feedback); on both platforms it can synthesize its own square-wave output.
